rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) sustained a bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to an icy condition, creating a premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on the policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are reporting medical bills. This is a premises liability claim with pediatric injury classified as high severity.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.injury_type: Broken wrist from slip and fall
case_facts.description: Child slipped on icy walkway during ice storm, sustained broken wrist
